messages:
Anya: Quick preflight — we need to align owners/deps for next runtime perf sprint (kernel + continuous batching + cache warmup). Can everyone confirm responsibilities? Also list any infra blockers.

Devin: I'm happy to own kernel perf work. Need the prefetch patch merged first. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4823

Simon: pinging @Rachel for canary infra readiness. Do we have small dedicated pool available for a canary run?

Rachel: @Simon we have capacity. Can do a 2-week canary starting Mon. I need ENG-1209 (infra ticket) assigned to set up the pool + routing.

Anya: Tentative split: Devin -> kernel, Simon -> batching config, Rachel -> KV warmup + canary infra. Speak up if that conflicts with other commitments.

deploy-bot: Canary pool allocated: pool-prod-canary-08 — GPUs: 4xA100. Status: scheduled (ETA tomorrow 10:00 UTC).

Devin: Thx. I posted a repro + perf snapshot in the PR. Short numbers: baseline tail p95=220ms -> target p95<=180ms. Diff lives in PR.

Devin:
```
# local perf run
bazel run //runtime/tools:perf -- --model t5-small --seq 1024 --qps 50
```

Simon: Two quick blockers: (1) tracing hooks need a small API change (PR 4831), (2) continuous-batching needs 'batch.max_latency_ms' exposed in infra config to tune at canary time.

Rachel: I'll add the config key. Suggest default 12 (ms). Naming: 'batch.max_latency_ms' ok?

Simon: Yes that's fine. Also can we run a smoke canary tomorrow at 10:00 to validate the knob + kernel change?

Anya: Schedule confirmed. Devin — please add a checklist to the PR: merge -> canary -> perf run -> rollback criteria (error rate or p95 regression). I'll track on the sprint board.

Devin: Will add checklist and ping @Sophia for kernel perf review once CI passes.

Sophia: Happy to review after CI. Quick note: include a tiny flamegraph in the PR if possible.

Anya: Thanks all :pray: I’ll post a short summary in the sprint channel after the smoke run.
